purpose: Forward execution research with actual future books/tape, paper fills, cash and positions; all eight hourly forecasts retained, no real orders
decision_rule: Choose at most one highest estimated net-edge contract/side per model and scenario per slot using that slot's frozen probabilities and book. Probability haircut 0.03; fee-aware limit floor to cents; separate 100 dollar accounts; 0.25 fractional Kelly using haircut probability and anticipated unit cost. Whole intended contracts, fractional fills down to 0.01. If quantity rounds below one, abstain. No statistical lower-confidence-bound claim.
taker_execution: Submit immutable paper limit order first; wait registered delay; request fresh book only after arrival due. Use actual receipt as simulated arrival. Walk opposite-side depth with retention and slippage once, within fixed limit, partial IOC then cancel residue. Reject stale/slow/malformed/closed books. No maker-price or midpoint fills.
maker_execution: At decision improve current best same-side bid by 0.01 when possible, capped below current ask and fee-aware probability limit. At delayed arrival reject any post-only crossing. Queue ahead is full displayed same-side size at or above our limit. Only non-block public prints with opposite taker direction and strictly lower same-side price consume queue; after queue consumed retain only 25% excess printed volume. A touch never fills; book cancellations never advance queue. Deduplicate trade IDs per order. Venue-style expiry is 60 seconds after scheduled arrival, capped before close; never infer fills from data first received after expiry. Missing tape means no maker fill.
fees: Resolve contemporaneous public series/event schedule at decision; reject a changed/unsupported schedule at arrival. Actual 2026 fee accumulator applied across partial fills. Reserve max quadratic fee plus rounding allowance. No live account credentials or order endpoint.
risk: At most 5% account equity committed to one hourly event, 10% to all Miami weather exposure including pending reservations, 25% total global ceiling, no cash overdraft. 20% drawdown from marked equity peak halts new paper orders and cancels resting orders. Initial single-city cluster limit is stricter than total limit.
monitoring: Poll relevant trade tape while maker orders rest; mark positions with fresh liquidating bids (unfilled remainder zero); only finalize against exchange finalized results with unchanged event membership and strike predicates. Persist account/order/fill/cancel/settlement events before updating memory; replay on restart. Restart cancels outstanding orders instead of inventing offline fills. Settlement can remain pending at bounded stop and be resumed.
limits: Paper fills remain simulations: polling can miss fleeting quotes/hidden queue changes, hypothetical orders have no market impact, timing includes observed collection latency, and no short run establishes profitability. Current models previously lost development scores; paper trades test execution/research, not validated recommendations. All 32 model/scenario accounts belong to the candidate family.
